method: Single direct built-UI comparison on identical 6001-line synthetic file; baseline exported from verified commit into ignored artifacts, both use mocked API results/inputs. Main CDP TaskDuration includes form events, response/Worker delivery, React rendering, and layout. One run per version, diagnostic not a stable population percentile. Cancellation begins after Worker analysis-start signal during a six-file nested workload. Target disappearance is not proof of immediate OS memory reclamation.
